reason: A directly targets the observed Cr–V precipitation with an experimentally supported Hf-alloying strategy and proposes a matched ~8 dpa/1073 K comparison using APT, TEM, and hardness testing. Although its specific ~7 at% Hf level and bulk-fabrication benefit are not established by the cited evidence, B is unsupported and assumes oxide defect sinks will suppress precipitation without added hardening, a mechanism that is neither demonstrated nor reliably expected in this already nanocrystalline alloy.
